purpose: Control the lifecycle of passive Discord proxy capture without breaking the primary browser.

off.description: System/browser traffic is not routed through mitmproxy.

observe_ready.description: mitmproxy service is listening locally, but no browser is forced through it.

cert_ready.description: mitmproxy CA is installed/trusted for the browser trust store.

browser_attached.description: A browser or proxy policy is routing selected traffic through mitmproxy.

discord_authenticated.description: Discord session is authenticated before capture-sensitive routes are proxied.

capture_active.description: Allowlisted Discord surfaces are producing raw_events/messages in SQLite.

degraded.description: Proxy is running but no Discord traffic or DB writes are observed.

blocked.description: Proxy interferes with login, TLS, websocket, or primary browser usability.

rollback.replacement: organ-discord Python entrypoint for browser-scoped proxy attach/detach
rollback.reason: legacy shell rollback entrypoints were removed during no-script-entrypoint transmutation
